params.body:
The README, read against the code. Only stale claims corrected and missing essentials added; language and structure kept. Every change with the file and line that justifies it:

# README review: ShaneDeconinck/good-governance

Default branch is `master` (HEAD 4255e14, 2026-09-10). No CLAUDE.md, no docs/ folder.

## Verified as still true (unchanged)

- Laravel 13, PHP ^8.3: `composer.json` `require.php: ^8.3`, `laravel/framework: ^13.17`. The caller's context called this a "Laravel 7 app"; the repository does not. (Laravel 7 is history: migrations from 2020, `2026_08_28_*` migrations bring the old schema up to date.)
- Vite 8, Vue 3, Tailwind 4: `package.json` devDependencies (`vite ^8.0.0`, `vue ^3.5.0`, `tailwindcss ^4.0.0`, `@tailwindcss/vite`), `vite.config.js`.
- Node 20.19+ / 22.12+: Vite 8 requirement; CI uses Node 22 (`.github/workflows/test.yml`, setup-node `node-version: '22'`).
- Env keys in step 3 all exist in `.env.example` (names checked); Mailgun packages in `composer.json` (`symfony/mailgun-mailer`, `symfony/http-client`); `.env.example` comment repeats the mg.-subdomain rule.
- `php artisan db:seed` seeds roles/permissions and the admin: `database/seeders/DatabaseSeeder.php` calls `RolesPermissionsSeeder` and `UserSeeder`.
- Pest: `pestphp/pest ^4.0` in composer.json; tests in `tests/Feature`, `tests/Unit`, `tests/Browser`.
- "two migrations of 2026-08-28": `database/migrations/2026_08_28_000000_rename_user_morph_type_to_app_models_user.php` and `2026_08_28_100000_index_users_code_and_email.php`.
- Staging `good-governance.on-forge.com` and production `https://www.sportbusinessgame.eu`: `elixir.json` environments.
- Admin code hashed, set on the "Change password" page: `app/Http/Controllers/PasswordResetController.php:26` (`Hash::make`); lookup in `app/Http/Controllers/Auth/LoginController.php:80-85`.
- Forge server IP, `releases/`/`current` layout, DNS at zxcs: not verifiable from the repository, left as written.

## Changed

- Intro: added "CI runs 8.4" and "CI runs Node 22". Source: `.github/workflows/test.yml` (`php-version: '8.4'`, `node-version: '22'`). "tested on 8.5" kept, not contradicted by the repo.
- Step 3: added `ELIXIR_TOKEN`, `NIGHTWATCH_ENABLED`, `NIGHTWATCH_TOKEN` to the env block plus a short paragraph. Sources: `config/elixir.php:6` (`env('ELIXIR_TOKEN')`), `app/Elixir/ElixirController.php` (abort 403 without matching bearer), `.env.example` (NIGHTWATCH_* keys and their comment about `php artisan nightwatch:agent`; ELIXIR_TOKEN is absent there, which the README now says).
- Step 6: split the test command into Unit/Feature and Browser, added Playwright install, the `npm run build` prerequisite, SQLite in-memory, and `composer test`. Sources: `.github/workflows/test.yml` (comment "Feature tests render Blade layouts that use @vite", steps `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`, `./vendor/bin/pest tests/Browser`), `phpunit.xml` (testsuites Unit and Feature only; `DB_CONNECTION=sqlite`, `DB_DATABASE=:memory:`), `composer.json` scripts `test`, `tests/Browser/GamePlaythroughTest.php`, `pestphp/pest-plugin-browser` in composer.json.
- Added the `composer setup` / `composer dev` line. Source: `composer.json` scripts `setup` and `dev`.
- New section "CI". Sources: `.github/workflows/test.yml` (on push to `master` and pull_request; pcov; clover `coverage.xml`; `abovebeyond-ai/elixir-quality@v1` with `if: always()`), `.github/workflows/evidence.yml` (on pull_request to `main`, `if: startsWith(github.head_ref, 'elixir/')`, `abovebeyond-ai/control-verify-action@v1` with `mode: pull`, header comment). The `main` vs `master` mismatch is stated as a fact from the file; see surprises.
- Hosting: added the scheduler requirement and the `/up` health route. Sources: `routes/console.php` (`Schedule::command('elixir:beat')->everyMinute()`), `bootstrap/app.php` (`health: '/up'`).
- New section "Elixir". Sources: `elixir.json` (environments, `gated: true`, `appHealth: /api/elixir`), `bootstrap/providers.php` (ElixirServiceProvider), `app/Elixir/ElixirServiceProvider.php` (routes `/api/elixir` and `/.well-known/build.json`, BeatCommand), `app/Elixir/ElixirController.php` (v2 sections, 403 gate), `app/Elixir/BuildStamp.php` (reads `.git/HEAD`, 404 without checkout), `config/elixir.php` (`jobs`, `backup_glob`, `extra`, all empty), `tests/Feature/ElixirEndpointTest.php` (header comment: module copied in, not required), `tests/Feature/BuildStampTest.php`.
- Logging in: corrected "team and team-member codes are generated by the app". The team code is entered by the admin on the add-team form (`app/Http/Controllers/TeamController.php:38-46`, `'code' => 'required|string|max:255|unique:users'`, stored as given); member codes are `Str::random(6)` in `GameSessionController.php:94` and the GG/SG3 variants. Plain text storage confirmed by `LoginController.php:80-83`.

## Surprises (not README claims, for the caller)

- `evidence.yml` filters `pull_request: branches: [main]`, but the repository's only branch is `master` (`git branch -a`, `gh api ... default_branch`). As written the Proof-of-Control merge check never runs on this repo. `test.yml` correctly uses `master`.
- The caller's context described the project as Laravel 7; the checkout is Laravel 13 (`^13.17`) with Laravel 13 app structure (`bootstrap/app.php` with `Application::configure`, `bootstrap/providers.php`).
- `database/seeders/UserSeeder.php` and `TestUserSeeder.php` contain a hardcoded admin login code and personal e-mail addresses; `db:seed` in production creates that admin. Not changed in the README (it says "the admin account" and does not name the code).

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
